newsitem.title: ITALY: Fossil of 150 mln-yr-old crocodile found in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Fossil of 150 mln-yr-old crocodile found in Italy.

text.p: An Italian tourist has discovered a fossilised crocodile believed to be 150 million years old in a breakwater near the famous lagoon city of Venice, officials said on Wednesday.

Mino Donatello stumbled across the crocodile while out for a stroll along the dam earlier this month. Experts estimated the crocodile was four metres (13 feet) long and were already talking of an exceptional discovery.

The skull and part of the backbone of the crocodile were visible in a block of stone which came from an upland plain in northeastern Italy and which was used by local authorities to build the breakwater.
University experts examined the fossil, which was due to be handed over to a museum in Chioggia, south of Venice this week.
